archetypes.name: path-derivation-audit
archetypes.rationale: The plan's core mechanism — SESSION_TMPDIR auto-narrows because it equals dirname(MANIFEST_PATH) — is asserted without quoting the launcher source; verify the derivation is accurate and that no other consumer reads the old root-level paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify in `scripts/launch-codex-implement.sh` that SESSION_TMPDIR is actually derived as `dirname("$MANIFEST_PATH")` and not computed independently from `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR` or a sibling env var that would not auto-narrow when MANIFEST_PATH moves. Check whether any script other than `step-7a.sh` reads `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/codex-impl-transcript.txt`, `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/manifest.json`, or `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/qa-pending.json` directly — grep `step2-implement.sh`, `step-7a.sh`, any `step-*.sh`, and `ship-pr*.sh` for these literal path suffixes to confirm the plan's file-list is exhaustive. Confirm the plan's MANIFEST_DIR existence check ordering: `mkdir -p "$STEP2_OUT_DIR"` must precede the launcher's MANIFEST_DIR guard, and the plan must name this ordering explicitly. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-table-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan enumerates a specific table of 15+ test-case IDs in test-step2-dispatch.sh that need STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH updated; any omission or wrong exclusion in that table will leave a test silently pointing at a path that no longer exists.
archetypes.prompt_body: Open `skills/implement/scripts/test-step2-dispatch.sh` and enumerate every location that sets `STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH` with a codex-path stub, then cross-reference against the plan's update table (tests 12a, 12b, 13, 16, 17a–17c, 18, M1, M2, M12, M16, M17, M18×2, M19, 25). Flag any codex-path stubs the table omits and any entries the table includes that are cursor-only or runtime-failure tests (e.g. test 24). Verify that META17A/B/C in the plan (e.g. `$TMP17A/codex-step2-out/codex-impl-transcript.txt.meta`) match the actual suffix used by the launcher for `.meta` files. Check that the transcript-dir mismatch assertion's expected substring (`"must share the parent directory"`) matches the exact `larch_err` message string proposed in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: split-dependency-isolation
archetypes.rationale: The plan is explicitly blocked by #3305 and defers subdir naming and helper-sharing decisions to #3305's outcome; if this plan cannot stand alone or conflicts with a different #3305 resolution, the implement run will produce an incompatible layout.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess whether the plan contains enough self-contained specification to implement correctly without knowing #3305's final decisions: does it fully define `codex-step2-out/` as the canonical subdir name, or does it only reference #3305's approach by example? Check `.claude/rules/external-tool-launcher-parity.md` and `.claude/rules/launcher-argv-test-coverage.md` to confirm the plan's proposed bullet additions are consistent with the existing rule structure and do not contradict existing text. Verify that the `scripts/launch-codex-implement.md` update (removing the "Codex-writable" statement) and `skills/implement/scripts/step2-implement.md` update (adding codex-only subdir note) are complete enough for an operator reading only those .md siblings — not the issue — to understand the new layout. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
